split.note: flows of each (capture, family) sorted by start time; first 70% train, next 15% validation, last 15% test

label_coverage.rule: families below the budget are excluded from training and macro-F1; their flows stay in the corpus with label kept for audits

projection.pca_fit_scope: all corpus train rows including unresolved; no validation/test
projection.split_note: time-forward within capture and family; shared 5-tuple groups across splits are expected and reported

audit3.interpretation: L1 counts flows the pipeline cannot tell apart at all (label-side floor). The increase from L1 to L2/L3 is information discarded by the representation. Oracle ceiling = majority label per identical group on test.
